text:
ops-bot: ALERT: multiple control-plane health checks failing in zrh1. API latency spikes then 504s. auto-detect: full region control-plane unreachable. :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: seeing the same — dashboards show control-plane API down for last 90s. Pod restarts on the control plane are spiking.

maria: confirmed from logs: etcd leader elections flapping and kube-apiserver 503s. I can't reach the apiservers from the control-plane nodes.

hiro: verified network-level: BGP sessions to zrh1 edge are established but internal overlay shows heavy packet drops between az-a and az-c. traceroute from bastion => large tail latencies.

leah: starting runbook 'region-controlplane-silence' steps 1-3. Copying commands: 
```
kubectl --context=zrh1-control get pods -n redwood-control -o wide
curl -sS https://zrh1-api.redwood.ai/health || true
```

aj: ran the curl — times out at tcp connect. control-plane port 6443 not accepting.

infra-manager: any active maints with provider? I checked tickets, nothing scheduled. pinging cloud-support.

cloud-support: we see an internal network fabric flap affecting our zrh1 control plane L2 segments. Engineers are engaged. Provisioning & API control-plane nodes are in a degraded state.

maria: impact scope? Which workloads affected?

hiro: management-plane only so far but data plane metrics show increased token latency for hosted-api in zrh1 because routes prefer local control for KV cache. Some instances started failing health checks and were drained.

leah: prod traffic hitting zrh1 is ~14% of EU traffic. We should decide: immediate global failover or staged traffic shift.

sre-oncall: recommend staged shift — enable 50% reroute to eu-west4, 30% to eu-west3, keep 20% with fast retry to zrh1 for cached sessions. Canary for 5m then ramp.

aj: note: eu-west4 has limited spare GPU headroom. Dedicated pools can absorb ~40% burst but will add high on-demand costs. We can also spin short-lived smaller quantized instances but that increases 99th latency.

infra-manager: cost vs availability: prefer immediate safety. Authorize burst to dedicated-reserve + on-demand fallback for next 2 hours?

maria: set routing policy: `rollout.from=regional-fallback; weight(zrh1)=20; weight(eu-west4)=50; weight(eu-west3)=30` — applying now.

ops-bot: EXEC: applying traffic weights to edge balancers: success (txn id 0a9f).

status-bot: Incident created: ZRH1-CTRL-2026-01. Notifying status.redwood.ai and customers with impacted dedicated clusters.

cloud-support: provider ETA on fabric repair ~45-60m. We'll push for faster.

leah: can someone open a quick customer message for high-usage tenants in zrh1? mention degraded region + active reroute and potential elevated latency/cost.

aj: drafting now. include note about possible token-rate throttles and longer tail latencies if they rely on local KV cache.

sre-oncall: monitoring failover metrics. If error rate > 5% after ramp, we'll execute full cutover.

maria: continuing control-plane debugging: capturing apiserver core dumps and etcd snapshots, will share in thread.

hiro: also enabling cross-region KV proxy to reduce dependency on zrh1 local cache.

infra-manager: good. keep running the runbook and update every 10m. If provider ETA slips, escalate to Exec oncall.

status-bot: Next update scheduled in 10 minutes.

maria: UPDATE 10:05 — control-plane still flapping, but traffic shift holding. No customer-visible errors beyond increased latency for long requests.

sre-oncall: standing by for provider progress. thanks all. :thumbsup:
